about: IROS 2027, the IEEE/RSJ conference on intelligent robots and systems, takes place at the Fortezza da Basso in Florence, Italy, from late September to 1 October 2027. The IEEE Robotics and Automation Society lists the paper submission deadline as March 1, 2027.
